02 · Motion grammar

Purpose before animation

SaveSubtle state confirmation; no layout movement.
Carry forwardDirectional movement toward the next stage.
SupersedeOld value recedes while remaining visible.
RevealContext expands near the object it explains.
Route changeProgress line advances to the next station.
Fast · 120–180msHover, focus, selection.
Standard · 220–320msPanels, save confirmation, inline expansion.
Travel · 350–550msStage progression and carried information.
Reduced motionReplace travel with immediate state change and clear text.
03 · Agent handoff

Motion brief

Use motion only to explain: - save confirmation - information carried to another stage - supersession of an earlier value - provenance revealed in context - route progression - inspector opening or closing TIMING - 120–180ms for hover, focus, and selection. - 220–320ms for panels and inline state changes. - 350–550ms for travel between stages. RULES - Do not animate every card on load. - Do not use bouncing, floating, or decorative parallax. - Preserve spatial continuity. - Reduced-motion mode must communicate the same state change immediately through text and layout. - Motion must never delay critical actions or hide history.
